text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 25, 2021) for 6 Rose Park Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed Item 1 in the Order to Comply (November 25, 2021) for 6 Rose Park Drive, Folder Number 21 243343 PRS 00 IV and, in doing so, granted an extension of time as follows: a. remove all items necessary to ensure a clear path for emergency egress by February 4, 2022; and b. remove all other waste and debris, as described in the Order to Comply, by April 29, 2022. 2. Rescinded Items 2, 3 and 4 in the Order to Comply (November 25, 2021) for 6 Rose Park Drive, Folder Number: 21 243343 PRS 00 IV.
